proposals.before: Chancellor Chen Ping memorialized: 'I have respectfully deliberated with Marquis of Jiang Bo, Marquis of Quzhou Shang, Marquis of Yingyin Ying, Marquis of Anguo Ling, and others. The marquises have fortunately received bestowed meal allowances and fief incomes. Your Majesty adds further favor by establishing court positions according to the order of their merits. I request that these rankings be preserved in the Gao Temple.'
proposals.after: Chancellor Chen Ping memorialized: 'I have respectfully deliberated with Bo, Marquis of Jiang; Shang, Marquis of Quzhou; Ying, Marquis of Yingyin; Ling, Marquis of Anguo; and others. The marquises have fortunately received bestowed meal allowances and fief incomes. Your Majesty adds further favor by establishing court positions according to the order of their merits. I request that these rankings be preserved in the Gao Temple.'
proposals.reason: The fused forms 'Marquis of Jiang Bo' etc. make the given name look like part of the place-name; the Chinese pairs fief title with the minister's given name.

proposals.before: Chancellor Chen Ping said: 'I have respectfully deliberated with Marquis of Jiang Bo, Marquis of Quzhou Shang, Marquis of Yingyin Ying, Marquis of Anguo Ling, and others. proposals.after: Chancellor Chen Ping said: 'I have respectfully deliberated with Bo, Marquis of Jiang; Shang, Marquis of Quzhou; Ying, Marquis of Yingyin; Ling, Marquis of Anguo; and others. The marquises have fortunately received bestowed meal allowances and fief incomes. Your Majesty adds further favor by establishing court positions according to the order of their merits. proposals.reason: Same fused marquis-name pattern as in the idiomatic line; separate fief title from given name.

proposals.before: She assisted Emperor Gao in settling the realm; three men among her father, brothers, and associates with the emperor were enfeoffed as marquises.
proposals.after: She assisted Emperor Gao in settling the realm; three men among her father and brothers were enfeoffed as marquises under Emperor Gao.
proposals.reason: Literal invents 'associates with the emperor'; 父兄及高祖而侯者三人 means father/brothers who became marquises in Gaozu's time.

decisions.reason: Chinese 絳侯臣勃、曲周侯臣商、潁陰侯臣嬰、安國侯臣陵 pairs each fief title with the minister's given name; 'Marquis of Jiang Bo' etc. wrongly fuse the name into the title, while 'Bo, Marquis of Jiang' correctly separates them.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 絳侯臣勃、曲周侯臣商、潁陰侯臣嬰、安國侯臣陵

decisions.reason: Same structure as the idiomatic line: each 侯 title is followed by 臣 plus the given name alone; separating 'Bo, Marquis of Jiang' (and parallel forms) removes the fused-name error without changing sense.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 絳侯臣勃、曲周侯臣商、潁陰侯臣嬰、安國侯臣陵

decisions.reason: In 父兄及高祖而侯者三人, 及高祖而侯 means those among her father and brothers who became marquises under Gaozu; the before invents 'associates with the emperor,' and the after matches the Chinese and the already-correct idiomatic reading.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 父兄及高祖而侯者三人
